**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 16,268 sessions (+12.4% WoW) | 11,385 users
- **Overall (GSC, organic search):** 3,337 clicks (-5.6% WoW) | 381,491 impressions (+13.3% WoW)

- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 4,342 GA4 sessions (+0.9% WoW) all-traffic | 1,042 GSC clicks (-2.3% WoW) organic | 173,019 GSC impressions (+3.9% WoW)

- Pricing is the clearest AI-displacement signal this week: GA4 all-traffic up +12.5% while GSC organic clicks are down -26.2% — consistent with AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) sending traffic that GSC doesn't see. All-other-pages GA4 up +20.2% with GSC organic roughly flat reinforces the same pattern.

**New competitor activity**
- **Optimizely**'s /field-notes hub continues surfacing pages in tracking (134 pieces this week — likely a sitemap addition of mostly pre-existing content, not all net-new). The hub covers A/B testing, experimentation strategy, and AI-assisted marketing, targeting the same practitioners GrowthBook's blog serves. - **Amplitude Exp**'s /docs surfaced 21 pages covering in-app guides, surveys, heatmaps, and Flutter/React Native SDKs — targets developers evaluating feature and experimentation tooling.
- ⚠️ No new pages detected from **Statsig**, **LaunchDarkly**, **Harness**, **Flagsmith**, or **Unleash** — consistent with a monitoring gap, not a content pause.
